caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet or desk with a slanted top section and four layers of drawers. The cabinet stands on four rounded, turned feet. The top section has an angled, hinged flap with a central lock, and the wood grain is distinctly patterned in a lighter tone with a darker outline along the edges. Below the top compartment, there is a narrow horizontal drawer, followed by three progressively larger sets of drawers, each set consisting of two drawers side by side, outlined by darker wood borders. Each drawer is outfitted with a decorative keyhole escutcheon, positioned in the center of each drawer or drawer pair, and rendered in a contrasting, slightly metallic color. The overall hue of the cabinet is a combination of brown shades, with the main panels being lighter brown with prominent wood grain patterns, and the trim, frame, and edges being a darker brown. The background is plain and off-white, with some slight discoloration at the corners. There is a signature or inscription along the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Slant-Top Desk
